candidate_policies.always_hedged: Long spot/short matching perpetual base units continuously; negative funding is paid.
candidate_policies.positive_trailing: Enter while the trailing three published settlement rates have positive mean; otherwise flat.
candidate_policies.funding_rotation: Hold the top two positive trailing-three-rate assets ranked across the fixed eight-asset universe; idle sleeve cash remains idle.
candidate_policies.funding_hysteresis: Enter after a positive latest published rate; exit after three consecutive nonpositive rates; never short unlevered spot.
candidate_policies.risk_controlled: Positive trailing-three mean plus previous 24h realized volatility below10%, absolute observed spot/perp basis below1%, and isolated risk ratio exit at50%.

selection: five fixed defaults; no parameter search or numerical training selection
decision_clock: 00:01UTC daily plus first completed minute in each fresh-wallet phase
funding_predictor: only already settled rates, published settlement timestamp+1minute; three observations required for trailing means
quantity: fixed entry units until exit; explicit1000spotPEPE per1unit1000PEPE perpetual; common lot-size grid
stress: double all fees and slippage, one additional minute delay, half volume participation
terminal: predeclared close orders2minutes before end; partial residuals disclosed, not fabricated fills
execution_validity_gate: all base/stress sleeve terminal positions fully closed; otherwise historical hurdle pass is prohibited
pair_risk: flatten on >1% matched-base-unit imbalance persisting5minutes, or either leg liquidation; risk policy additionally exits maintenance+close-reserve/local-equity>=.5
criteria: validation return>0; holdout>0; jointstress>0; at least2of3positive anchored holdout months; Sharpe>=.5; minute maxdrawdown<=.2; >=5of8positive symbols
multiple_testing: five correlated variants of one carry family plus eight price/factor policies; conservative13-policy Bonferroni bootstrap tails
limitations: current fee/lot/risk metadata approximates historical rules
legs fill independently with volume/latency, no atomic exchange hedge
historical hurdle pass is not prospective edge proof
